engines.quant: L-Forster's OpenJet coding agent build, code workload, vs 73 tok/s in its llama.cpp test; the engine code and benchmarks are public (github.com/L-Forster/open-jet) and the poster is asking for reproductions

models.why: OpenJet reports 140 tok/s for code with Qwen3.8-27B on one RTX 3090 against 73 tok/s in its own llama.cpp test — nearly 1.9x from the serving build alone, published with its benchmark code so it can be reproduced.
